summary: The figure is a world map showing the maternal mortality ratio by country or area for the year 2020. Countries in Sub-Saharan Africa have the highest maternal mortality ratios, with several countries in the darkest red category (≥1000 per 100,000 live births). Most countries in Europe, North America, and Australia fall into the lowest categories (<20 or 20–99). Some countries have no data available or are marked as not applicable. The map visually highlights significant regional disparities in maternal mortality ratios globally.
